column2: Column Description
Unique number for each individual litterbag, values range from 1-240.

Experimental plots 1-6; plots 1, 4, and 6 correspond with elevated CO2 treatment. Plots 2,3, and 5 correspond with the ambient treatment.
Two levels, ambient (litter collected from ambient plots), and elevated (litter collected from elevated CO2 plots).
Two levels, control (where plots receive ambient air, CO2 is not increased in the plot) and eCO2 (where plots contain elevated (+150 ppm) levels of CO2)
Four harvest points, labeled 1 (collected September 2020), 2 (collected January 2021), 3 (collected June 2021), and 4 (collected December 2021).
